olivia: quick RFC follow-up — users keep asking to downgrade precision mid-chat (fp8 -> int8/4bit) to cut cost. main concerns: kvcache compatibility, quality regressions, rollout complexity.

raj: short: possible but many surfaces. packing, scale/zero_point, and op_impl differences. need metadata per-KV block.

marco: engineering options we discussed:
- sync-requant: on switch, re-quantize cache synchronously (simple, latency spike).
- async-shadow: spawn background worker to produce target cache while serving old one, cutover when ready.
- dual-cache-for-hot: keep two encodings for hot convos (fast switch, memory overhead).
- canonical-intermediate: store compact fp16 and quantize on demand (memory/CPU trade).

chen: experiments needed: measure top-1 divergence, degscore, and PPL for fp8->int8 and fp8->int4 switches across retrieval-heavy and open-chat samples. i'll run a 5k-prefix harness.

ben: note memory tradeoffs. dual-cache doubles memory for persisted convos; for ephemeral in-RAM caches maybe only enable for convos > 60s or > 128 tokens.

lisa: ops items: header+schema version for persisted caches, backfill migration job, metrics (precision_switch_failures, requant_latency_ms, degscore_99p). rollout: 2w shadow -> 1% canary -> 10% -> ramp.

olivia: header sketch (small): version, model, layer, shape, bitwidth, scale_hash, op_impl, created_ts. keep <64B.

raj: runtime policy: if bitwidth+op_impl match -> fast path. else consult `kvcache_compat` (strict|best-effort|none). best-effort -> dequant->requant pipeline and trace the request. strict -> reject or force re-encode.

marco: implement `requant_worker` as bounded background pool to avoid tail latency. fallback path should record `requant_time_ms` and tag responses.

chen: telemetry: emit precision_trace event per-request with old_precision,new_precision,cache_action,requant_time_ms,degscore_sample. store sample payloads for postmortem.

ben: alternative approach: keep blockwise fp16 canonical to speed conversions (less mem than fp32). need measurement.

olivia: quick local repro (200 prefixes): fp8->int4 median top1-prob L1=0.11, median degscore=0.025, 95p degscore tail worse on retrieval contexts.

lisa: product/billing question: per-response pricing seems simplest but product to confirm refund/credits policy for retroactive cheaper routing. require opt-in per-session flag: allow_precision_switch.

olivia: action items: raj -> header RFC + runtime decision matrix; marco + ben -> worker + dual-cache prototype; chen -> experiment harness + dashboard; lisa -> migration & canary playbook.
